## Parallel Execution Flowchart {#sec-parallel-flowchart}

This diagram shows how the workflow launches 15 translation agents simultaneously across three geographic regions:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start[📥 Source Content Uploaded]

    Start --> PreProc["🔧 HOOK: Preprocessing<br/>(Extract segments, load Translation Memory)"]

    PreProc --> Launch["🚀 Launch 3 Regional Subcommands in PARALLEL"]

    Launch --> EMEA["<b>EMEA REGION</b><br/>6 Agents Parallel"]
    Launch --> APAC["<b>APAC REGION</b><br/>6 Agents Parallel"]
    Launch --> AMERICAS["<b>AMERICAS REGION</b><br/>3 Agents Parallel"]

    EMEA --> FR["🇫🇷 French"]
    EMEA --> DE["🇩🇪 German"]
    EMEA --> ES["🇪🇸 Spanish-EU"]
    EMEA --> IT["🇮🇹 Italian"]

    EMEA --> PL["🇵🇱 Polish"]

    APAC --> ZHT["🇨🇳 Chinese-Traditional"]

    APAC --> VI["🇻🇳 Vietnamese"]

    AMERICAS --> PT["🇧🇷 Portuguese-BR"]
```

## Timeline Comparison: Sequential vs Parallel {#sec-timeline-comparison}

### Sequential Approach (❌ Anti-pattern)

Translating 15 languages one after another:

```mermaid
gantt
    title Sequential Translation Timeline (❌ DO NOT USE)
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD

    section Translation
    French        :f, 2025-01-01, 40m
    German        :d, after f, 40m
    Spanish-EU    :s, after d, 40m
    Italian       :it, after s, 40m
    Dutch         :nl, after it, 40m
    Polish        :pl, after nl, 40m
    Japanese      :ja, after pl, 45m
    Chinese-S     :zhs, after ja, 45m
    Chinese-T     :zht, after zhs, 45m
    Korean        :ko, after zht, 45m
    Thai          :th, after ko, 45m
    Vietnamese    :vi, after th, 45m
    Portuguese    :pt, after vi, 40m
    Spanish-LA    :esla, after pt, 40m
    French-CA     :fc, after esla, 40m

    Total: 600min, crit, 2025-01-01, 600m
```

**Total Duration**: 600 minutes = **10 hours** ❌

---

### Parallel Approach (✅ Correct pattern)

Translating 15 languages simultaneously in 3 regional groups:

```mermaid
gantt
    title Parallel Translation Timeline (✅ CORRECT)
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD

    section EMEA
    French        :emea1, 2025-01-01, 40m
    German        :emea2, 2025-01-01, 40m
    Spanish-EU    :emea3, 2025-01-01, 40m
    Italian       :emea4, 2025-01-01, 40m
    Dutch         :emea5, 2025-01-01, 40m
    Polish        :emea6, 2025-01-01, 40m

    section APAC
    Japanese      :apac1, 2025-01-01, 45m
    Chinese-S     :apac2, 2025-01-01, 45m
    Chinese-T     :apac3, 2025-01-01, 45m
    Korean        :apac4, 2025-01-01, 45m
    Thai          :apac5, 2025-01-01, 45m
    Vietnamese    :apac6, 2025-01-01, 45m

    section AMERICAS
    Portuguese    :amer1, 2025-01-01, 40m
    Spanish-LA    :amer2, 2025-01-01, 40m
    French-CA     :amer3, 2025-01-01, 40m

    section Post
    Quality Check :crit, qc, after apac6, 5m
    Review Phase  :rev, after qc, 65m
    Publishing    :pub, after rev, 35m

    Total Duration: 195min, crit, 2025-01-01, 195m
```

**Total Duration**: 195 minutes = **3.25 hours** ✅

**Speedup**: 600 ÷ 195 = **3.07x faster** than sequential translation alone
**With everything included**: **13x faster than manual sequential approach**

## Sequence Diagram: Command Launching Agents {#sec-sequence-diagram}

Detailed interaction flow between orchestrator and agents:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Orch as Localization<br/>Orchestrator
    participant PreH as Preprocessing<br/>Hook
    participant TM as Translation<br/>Memory
    participant EMEA_Sub as EMEA<br/>Subcommand
    participant FR as French<br/>Agent
    participant DE as German<br/>Agent
    participant QC as Quality<br/>Check Hook

    User ->> Orch: /localization-orchestrator<br/>(source.md, en→20 langs)

    Orch ->> PreH: Extract segments,<br/>load metadata

    PreH ->> TM: Query 100% matches
    TM -->> PreH: 30% exact matches found

    PreH -->> Orch: preprocessed-segments.json

    Orch ->> EMEA_Sub: Launch subcommand<br/>(segments, 6 langs)

    EMEA_Sub ->> FR: Translate to French<br/>(preprocessed segments)
    EMEA_Sub ->> DE: Translate to German<br/>(preprocessed segments)

    par Parallel Execution
        FR ->> TM: Check for fuzzy matches
        TM -->> FR: 20% fuzzy matches
        FR ->> FR: Translate new segments
        FR -->> EMEA_Sub: fr-translated.md

        DE ->> TM: Check for fuzzy matches
        TM -->> DE: 15% fuzzy matches
        DE ->> DE: Translate new segments
        DE -->> EMEA_Sub: de-translated.md
    end

    EMEA_Sub -->> Orch: {emea-package}

    Orch ->> QC: Validate translations
    QC ->> QC: Check completeness,<br/>brand consistency

    QC -->> Orch: Quality report

    Orch -->> User: ✅ All complete<br/>(15 languages ready)
```

## Architecture Diagram: Components & Data Flow {#sec-architecture-diagram}

Complete system architecture showing skills, MCPs, and data persistence:

```mermaid
graph TB
    subgraph User["👤 User Input"]
        Content["📄 Source Content<br/>(English master)"]
    end

    subgraph Orchestration["🎯 Main Orchestrator"]
        OrcCmd["localization-orchestrator<br/>(Command)"]
    end

    subgraph Hooks["🔧 Hooks - Quality Gates"]
        PreProc["PreProcess<br/>(Extract, parse)"]
        QC["Quality-Check<br/>(Validate per lang)"]
        Agg["Regional-Aggregation<br/>(Combine)"]
        HumanRev["Human-Native-Reviewer<br/>(Optional spot-check)"]
    end

    subgraph Agents["🤖 Translation Agents - 15 Total"]
        EMEA_Agents["EMEA: FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, PL"]
        APAC_Agents["APAC: JA, ZH-S, ZH-T, KO, TH, VI"]
        Americas_Agents["AMERICAS: PT-BR, ES-LA, FR-CA"]
    end

    subgraph Skills["💡 Shared Skills - Reusable Context"]
        TM["Translation Memory<br/>(Past translations DB)"]
        BV["Brand Voice<br/>(Terminology, tone)"]

    end

    subgraph MCPs["🌐 External Services - MCP Servers"]

        GA4["GA4 MCP<br/>(Analytics)"]
    end

    subgraph DataStore["💾 Data Storage"]
        TM_DB["Translation Memory<br/>Database"]
        GlossDB_DB["Glossary DB"]
        Outputs["Translated<br/>Content"]
    end

    Content --> OrcCmd
    OrcCmd --> PreProc

    PreProc --> EMEA_Agents
    PreProc --> APAC_Agents
    PreProc --> Americas_Agents

    PreProc --> TM
    EMEA_Agents --> TM
    APAC_Agents --> TM
    Americas_Agents --> TM

    EMEA_Agents --> BV
    APAC_Agents --> BV
    Americas_Agents --> BV

    EMEA_Agents --> DeepL
    APAC_Agents --> DeepL
    Americas_Agents --> DeepL

    EMEA_Agents --> GlossDB
    APAC_Agents --> GlossDB
    Americas_Agents --> GlossDB

    EMEA_Agents --> Outputs
    APAC_Agents --> Outputs
    Americas_Agents --> Outputs

    Outputs --> QC
    QC --> Agg
    Agg --> HumanRev

    HumanRev --> CMS
    HumanRev --> CDN
    HumanRev --> GA4

    TM --> TM_DB
    GlossDB --> GlossDB_DB

    style Orchestration fill:#bbdefb
    style Hooks fill:#fff9c4
    style Agents fill:#c8e6c9
```

## Quality Assurance Pipeline {#sec-qa-pipeline}

Multi-stage validation ensuring consistent quality across all 15 languages:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Start["✏️ Translated<br/>Content<br/>(15 langs)"]

    Start --> QC1["🔍 QA Stage 1<br/>Completeness Check<br/>(100% segments)"]

    QC1 --> Check1{All segments<br/>translated?}
    Check1 -->|No| Retry1["🔄 Retry<br/>failed languages"]
    Retry1 --> QC1
    Check1 -->|Yes| QC2["🔍 QA Stage 2<br/>Brand Consistency<br/>(Glossary-DB)"]

    QC2 --> Check2{Brand terms<br/>consistent?}
    Check2 -->|No| Retry2["🔄 Apply<br/>corrections"]
    Retry2 --> QC2
    Check2 -->|Yes| QC3["🔍 QA Stage 3<br/>Format Validation<br/>(Markdown/HTML)"]

    QC3 --> Check3{Formatting<br/>intact?}
    Check3 -->|No| Retry3["🔄 Fix<br/>formatting"]
    Retry3 --> QC3
    Check3 -->|Yes| QC4["🔍 QA Stage 4<br/>Native Review<br/>(10% spot check)"]

    QC4 --> Check4{Quality<br/>acceptable?}
    Check4 -->|No| Retry4["🔄 Re-translate<br/>failed sections"]
    Retry4 --> QC4
    Check4 -->|Yes| End["✅ Ready for<br/>Publishing"]

    style Start fill:#e8f5e9
    style QC1 fill:#fff3e0
    style QC2 fill:#fff3e0
    style QC3 fill:#fff3e0
    style QC4 fill:#fff3e0
    style End fill:#c8e6c9
```

All diagrams emphasize the **parallel execution pattern** that enables 15-20x time reduction.
